title: Nutty dense French corn rillettes
description: A rich and comforting French dish featuring poached corn and a nutty flavor.
instructions: In a large saucepan bring the chicken broth to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the corn kernels. Poach for 10-12 minutes or until tender.
Remove the corn from the broth with a slotted spoon and set aside.
In the same saucepan melt the butter over medium heat. Add the nutmeg, salt, and heavy cream. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked corn kernels to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until well combined.
Stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Transfer the rillettes to a shallow dish and sprinkle with chopped parsley and toasted almonds.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Note: Traditionally rillettes are served in small terrines or ramekins. You can also serve in small bowls or on toasted bread.
If you prefer a lighter consistency, you can add more chicken broth or heavy cream to the rillettes before serving.
For a gluten-free option, make sure to use a gluten-free chicken broth.
Nutrition information is an estimate and may vary based on specific ingredient brands and measurements.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
